about_the_game:
Make sure your heroes can visit the best weapon shop in town with the KR Fantasy Market - Weapons Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is back with their Fantasy Market series, this time offering up more than 50 different weapon types for your party to purchase. From daggers to war fans, clubs to katanas, boomerangs to crowbars, if your heroes need a weapon they’ll likely find it in this pack! 5 B sheets offer hundreds of weapon tiles to decorate your shops and give your players choices when it comes to equipment. Each weapon type comes in 3 sizes (with growing complexity) and 6 color variations that can show elemental strengths for the weapon, meaning you can offer daggers with water, wind, fire, or earth elemental buffs to make defeating some enemies easier. Or have your whip-wielding hero slowly upgrade his equipment from a simple whip to a two-headed whip to finally a devastating cat o’ nine tails. Choose unique weapons for each party member so that instead of a squad of swordmasters, your party consists of glaive users, masters of maces, miner-turned-fighters with pickaxes, sharpshooting sling-wielders, and more!

Don’t forget about mapping a shop! A2, A4, and B tile sheets are ready to help you build a shop with tables to display the different options and a forge where the store’s owner can make your hero new weapons if they bring her specific crafting ingredients. This pack also includes MV and MZ example projects to give you some more ideas for how to use the tiles. Pick up the KR Fantasy Market - Weapons Tileset and give each of your towns a wonderful weapon shop to visit!


The Fantasy Shop ~ Weapons Tileset Includes:


Ground tiles:

Cement, flat dirt, cobblestone, 4 colors of wood flooring in 2 directions, 4 colors of rugs (several shapes and styles) and 4 colors of tables, one with wood grain and one without.


Walls/roofs:

Includes woven wall texture, plus two types of wall with wood trim.


Also includes:

Basic interior design elements – fireplaces, windows, plants, stairs, etc
Blacksmith tiles – forge with animated lighting, anvil, vise, etc
Swords (several styles)
Spears
Lances
Tridents
Axes
Wands
Clubs
Multipurpose weapons – pipe, wrench, crowbar, pickaxe, etc
Hammers
Whips
Bows and crossbows
Slings and slingshots
Boomerangs
Dart guns
War fans
Chakram
Glove-based weapons (Cestus, tiger claws, etc)
Shuriken
Nunchaku
and many more! 50+ weapons!

All weapons include 3 different versions (increasing in size and detail) and each version has six elements available.
Icons included for all base weapon types.


Events and Animations:

Forge lighting animation


Terms of Use:

This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
OK to be used in Commercial projects
Contents can be edited
OK for use in games with gore
OK for use in adult-rated games
